findings.title: Scroll position kept across drill-down levels
findings.problem: The popup body is now the single scroll container shared by all stacked sections; drilling into or back from a level does not reset its scrollTop, so a new level can open scrolled partway down.
findings.impact: Only on short viewports after the user scrolled the body; the breadcrumb lives in the popup header so it stays visible and the user can scroll up. Cosmetic/usability.
findings.recommendation: Reset the body scroll on activeIndex change, e.g. a ref on the body and useEffect(() => { bodyRef.current?.scrollTo({ top: 0 }) }, [activeIndex]).
